## Weekly readings

Find readings, guiding questions, exercises, and deadlines on each weekly page.

## ML computational-economics literature

The final part of the course explores recent computational-economics research using machine-learning methods. Readings will be announced on the weekly pages.

For each paper, we will examine:

- The economic question and model.
- The computational bottleneck and proposed ML method.
- Benchmarks, accuracy checks, and limitations.
- Available code/data and a possible small replication exercise.
- Reading questions and a topic-based slide deck.

## Research-agent and tool readings

Lab readings cover research workflows using LLM agents, Git, and related tools. Each weekly page will link to the relevant documentation and activities.
